title: Missing Beat · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Missing Beat · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Agree on a four-beat clap pattern with one silent beat. A partner performs the pattern once; the lead identifies the silent beat by number. The identified beat matches the agreed silent beat. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: A timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Missing Beat, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The identified beat matches the agreed silent beat.
recall.why: The identified beat matches the agreed silent beat.
